Coastline is a Minecraft server built around making Minecraft the best it can be. Featuring a wide variety* of games, vast SMPs, and a very nice Discord server. ## Some photos ## Security Check Coastline is currently in beta. To keep the server safe, you need to join the Discord and check in before you start playing. This tells us you're not a bot. ## FAQs
Can this run on my device? This modpack is built for version 1.21.1 and runs best on the latest version of Java. A low-tuned version of Complementary Shaders is available by default, and should run fine on most devices. The pack also includes a multitude of performance-enhancement mods; there's a chance that Coastline will run better at times than vanilla Minecraft.
What's on this server? Just one big SMP right now. That doesn't make it any less fun. We've got quite a lot going on.
